resources.string: Put some time on your calendar to take a walk outside or maybe even take a meeting while you\'re strolling through your neighborhood.
Listen to a podcast and explore a topic you\'ve been itching to learn more about or discover a completely new topic or genre.
Choose a drawer, a shelf, or your desktop. Spend 10 minutes organizing it. A clear space often leads to a clear mind.
Find a recipe you\'ve never tried before. It doesn\'t have to be complex—just something fresh to tickle your taste buds.
Put your phone in another room and turn off screens. Read a book, draw, or just sit and relax without notifications.
Reach out to someone you haven\'t spoken to in a while. A quick 10-minute catch-up call can boost your mood significantly.
Before bed, write down three things that made you smile today. Focusing on the positive helps improve sleep quality.
